stem.text: A solid wooden cube rests on a horizontal surface.
What gives the pressure exerted by the weight of the cube on the horizontal surface?

A.text: the product of the acceleration of free fall and the density of the cube

B.text: the product of the acceleration of free fall, the density and the side length of the cube

C.text: the product of the acceleration of free fall, the density and the area of one face of the cube

D.text: the product of the acceleration of free fall, the density and the volume of the cube
